messages.subject: Additive Effects
parts:
Dear Prof Broman, in the estimation of additive effects, after getting the parental genotypes, please which of them should I use as AA or BB? Should the pollinator come first or recipient (paternal or maternal)? I have a NAM population and I am also performing Linkage mapping with each family. The common parent was used as the pollinator.

Thanks.

Marcus.

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Additive Effects
